name: @sauce/async
description: SauceScript's promises: a request now, a callback later, settled once into the `.then` or `.catch` body it parked, as the same Private Pot. `Request` is the promise a protocol package's request returns; `Promise` holds all/race/any/allSettled/resolve/reject/withResolvers; `Async` settles a promise by key in a later transaction, expires one past its deadline and makes a timeout. The settlement table, `fulfil`/`reject` (once, a late callback a no-op), `settleCarried`, the handler checks and `install`/`declareInterface` are its run-time half. `handlers` is the Pot's public `expire(bytes32)`, installed with every package of the family. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (async.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the handlers a callback lands on are a Private Pot's Router's.
